requirements.command: bcs-cli session create + session list + session get + session patch
requirements.expectation: PM creates one release Session inside the exact CLI-managed Group, and independent CLI list, get, and patch reads keep its session ID, group binding, title, and renamed title consistent; persisted input is never treated as downstream execution completion.

requirements.command: bcs-cli session add-member + set-member-mode + get + chat + messages + invite-link + remove-member + get
requirements.expectation: PM governs only the owned QA membership in the exact Session: add, mute, read, chat, and message-history operations are observable, the invite returns token and join URL, and QA is absent only after removal. Chat and history never invent delivery results.
PM completes the exact owned Session and receives completed with its exact output payload; completion is not inferred from a missing or synthetic response.

requirements.command: bcs-cli service invoke --detach + service status + service wait
requirements.expectation: PM invokes one detached group service in the owned Group and keeps service session identity and group binding through status; bounded wait reports either a terminal completed record or the exact session-specific timeout contract, never an unbounded or synthetic terminal state; the owned chat Session, exact bot-owned service Session, and its Group are then cleaned up with creator-scoped requests.
